title: Federal rule: Order No. 918; Critical Infrastructure Protection Reliability Standard CIP-003-11-Cyber Security-Security…
summary: Energy Department / Federal Energy Regulatory Commission published the rule "Order No. 918; Critical Infrastructure Protection Reliability Standard CIP-003-11-Cyber Security-Security Management Controls" in the Federal Register on 2026-03-24 (91 FR 13952), effective 2026-05-26.
